    have h₁₀ : a 1 * y + a 2 * z = 0 := by
      have h₁₀₁ : a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z = 0 := h₇
      rw [hx] at h₁₀₁
      linarith
    have h₁₁ : a 4 * y + a 5 * z = 0 := by
      have h₁₁₁ : a 3 * x + a 4 * y + a 5 * z = 0 := h₈
      rw [hx] at h₁₁₁
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : (a 5 * a 1 - a 4 * a 2) * y = 0 := by
      have h₁₂₁ : a 5 * (a 1 * y + a 2 * z) = 0 := by
        calc
          a 5 * (a 1 * y + a 2 * z) = a 5 * 0 := by rw [h₁₀]
          _ = 0 := by ring
      have h₁₂₂ : a 2 * (a 4 * y + a 5 * z) = 0 := by
        calc
          a 2 * (a 4 * y + a 5 * z) = a 2 * 0 := by rw [h₁₁]
          _ = 0 := by ring
      have h₁₂₃ : a 5 * a 1 * y + a 5 * a 2 * z = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₄ : a 4 * a 2 * y + a 5 * a 2 * z = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₅ : a 5 * a 1 * y - a 4 * a 2 * y = 0 := by linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₃ : a 5 * a 1 - a 4 * a 2 > 0 := by
      have h₁₃₁ : a 1 < 0 := h₁.1
      have h₁₃₂ : a 5 < 0 := h₂.1
      have h₁₃₃ : a 4 > 0 := h₀.2.1
      have h₁₃₄ : a 2 < 0 := h₁.2
      have h₁₃₅ : a 5 * a 1 > 0 := by nlinarith
      have h₁₃₆ : a 4 * a 2 < 0 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have h₁₄ : y = 0 := by
      have h₁₄₁ : (a 5 * a 1 - a 4 * a 2) * y = 0 := h₁₂
      have h₁₄₂ : a 5 * a 1 - a 4 * a 2 > 0 := h₁₃
      have h₁₄₃ : y = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (a 5 * a 1 - a 4 * a 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      exact h₁₄₃
    have h₁₅ : z = 0 := by
      have h₁₅₁ : a 1 * y + a 2 * z = 0 := h₁₀
      rw [h₁₄] at h₁₅₁
      have h₁₅₂ : a 2 * z = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₅₃ : a 2 < 0 := h₁.2
      have h₁₅₄ : z = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (a 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      exact h₁₅₄
    exact ⟨h₁₄, h₁₅⟩
  
  have h_y_zero : y = 0 → x = 0 ∧ z = 0 := by
    intro hy
    have h₁₀ : a 0 * x + a 2 * z = 0 := by
      have h₁₀₁ : a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z = 0 := h₇
      rw [hy] at h₁₀₁
      linarith
    have h₁₁ : a 6 * x + a 8 * z = 0 := by
      have h₁₁₁ : a 6 * x + a 7 * y + a 8 * z = 0 := h₉
      rw [hy] at h₁₁₁
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : (a 8 * a 0 - a 6 * a 2) * x = 0 := by
      have h₁₂₁ : a 8 * (a 0 * x + a 2 * z) = 0 := by
        calc
          a 8 * (a 0 * x + a 2 * z) = a 8 * 0 := by rw [h₁₀]
          _ = 0 := by ring
      have h₁₂₂ : a 2 * (a 6 * x + a 8 * z) = 0 := by
        calc
          a 2 * (a 6 * x + a 8 * z) = a 2 * 0 := by rw [h₁₁]
          _ = 0 := by ring
      have h₁₂₃ : a 8 * a 0 * x + a 8 * a 2 * z = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₄ : a 2 * a 6 * x + a 2 * a 8 * z = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₅ : a 8 * a 0 * x - a 2 * a 6 * x = 0 := by linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₃ : a 8 * a 0 - a 6 * a 2 > 0 := by
      have h₁₃₁ : a 0 > 0 := h₀.1
      have h₁₃₂ : a 8 > 0 := h₀.2.2
      have h₁₃₃ : a 6 > 0 := h₃.1
      have h₁₃₄ : a 2 < 0 := h₁.2
      nlinarith [h₀.1, h₀.2.1, h₀.2.2, h₁.1, h₁.2, h₂.1, h₂.2, h₃.1]
    have h₁₄ : x = 0 := by
      have h₁₄₁ : (a 8 * a 0 - a 6 * a 2) * x = 0 := h₁₂
      have h₁₄₂ : a 8 * a 0 - a 6 * a 2 > 0 := h₁₃
      have h₁₄₃ : x = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (a 8 * a 0 - a 6 * a 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      exact h₁₄₃
    have h₁₅ : z = 0 := by
      have h₁₅₁ : a 0 * x + a 2 * z = 0 := h₁₀
      rw [h₁₄] at h₁₅₁
      have h₁₅₂ : a 2 * z = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₅₃ : a 2 < 0 := h₁.2
      have h₁₅₄ : z = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (a 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      exact h₁₅₄
    exact ⟨h₁₄, h₁₅⟩
  
  have h_z_zero : z = 0 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h₁₀ : a 0 * x + a 1 * y = 0 := by
      have h₁₀₁ : a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z = 0 := h₇
      rw [hz] at h₁₀₁
      linarith
    have h₁₁ : a 6 * x + a 7 * y = 0 := by
      have h₁₁₁ : a 6 * x + a 7 * y + a 8 * z = 0 := h₉
      rw [hz] at h₁₁₁
      linarith
    have h₁₂ : (a 7 * a 0 - a 6 * a 1) * x = 0 := by
      have h₁₂₁ : a 7 * (a 0 * x + a 1 * y) = 0 := by
        calc
          a 7 * (a 0 * x + a 1 * y) = a 7 * 0 := by rw [h₁₀]
          _ = 0 := by ring
      have h₁₂₂ : a 1 * (a 6 * x + a 7 * y) = 0 := by
        calc
          a 1 * (a 6 * x + a 7 * y) = a 1 * 0 := by rw [h₁₁]
          _ = 0 := by ring
      have h₁₂₃ : a 7 * a 0 * x + a 7 * a 1 * y = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₄ : a 1 * a 6 * x + a 1 * a 7 * y = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₅ : a 7 * a 0 * x - a 1 * a 6 * x = 0 := by linarith
      linarith
    have h₁₃ : a 7 * a 0 - a 6 * a 1 > 0 := by
      have h₁₃₁ : a 0 > 0 := h₀.1
      have h₁₃₂ : a 7 < 0 := h₃.2
      have h₁₃₃ : a 6 > 0 := h₃.1
      have h₁₃₄ : a 1 < 0 := h₁.1
      nlinarith [h₀.1, h₀.2.1, h₀.2.2, h₁.1, h₁.2, h₂.1, h₂.2, h₃.1]
    have h₁₄ : x = 0 := by
      have h₁₄₁ : (a 7 * a 0 - a 6 * a 1) * x = 0 := h₁₂
      have h₁₄₂ : a 7 * a 0 - a 6 * a 1 > 0 := h₁₃
      have h₁₄₃ : x = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (a 7 * a 0 - a 6 * a 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      exact h₁₄₃
    have h₁₅ : y = 0 := by
      have h₁₅₁ : a 0 * x + a 1 * y = 0 := h₁₀
      rw [h₁₄] at h₁₅₁
      have h₁₅₂ : a 1 * y = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₅₃ : a 1 < 0 := h₁.1
      have h₁₅₄ : y = 0 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (a 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      exact h₁₅₄
    exact ⟨h₁₄, h₁₅⟩
  
  have h_main : x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0 := by
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · -- Case: x = 0
      have h₁ : y = 0 ∧ z = 0 := h_x_zero hx
      have h₂ : y = 0 := h₁.1
      have h₃ : z = 0 := h₁.2
      exact ⟨hx, h₂, h₃⟩
    · -- Case: x ≠ 0
      by_cases hy : y = 0
      · -- Subcase: y = 0
        have h₁ : x = 0 ∧ z = 0 := h_y_zero hy
        have h₂ : x = 0 := h₁.1
        have h₃ : z = 0 := h₁.2
        exfalso
        apply hx
        linarith
      · -- Subcase: y ≠ 0
        have h₁ : z = 0 := by
          by_contra hz
          -- If z ≠ 0, then we have a contradiction because neither x, y, nor z can be zero
          have h₂ : z ≠ 0 := hz
          have h₃ : x = 0 := by
            apply hx
            linarith
          linarith
        -- If z = 0, then x = 0 and y = 0, which contradicts x ≠ 0 or y ≠ 0
        have h₂ : x = 0 ∧ y = 0 := h_z_zero h₁
        have h₃ : x = 0 := h₂.1
        have h₄ : y = 0 := h₂.2
        exfalso
        apply hx
        linarith
  
  exact h_main

have h₁₀ : x = 0 := by
    by_contra hx
    have h₁₁ : a 0 > 0 := h₀.1
    have h₁₂ : a 4 > 0 := h₀.2.1
    have h₁₃ : a 8 > 0 := h₀.2.2
    have h₁₄ : a 1 < 0 := h₁.1
    have h₁₅ : a 2 < 0 := h₁.2
    have h₁₆ : a 3 < 0 := h₂.1
    have h₁₇ : a 5 < 0 := h₂.2
    have h₁₈ : a 6 < 0 := h₃.1
    have h₁₉ : a 7 < 0 := h₃.2
    have h₂₀ : 0 < a 0 + a 1 + a 2 := h₄
    have h₂₁ : 0 < a 3 + a 4 + a 5 := h₅
    have h₂₂ : 0 < a 6 + a 7 + a 8 := h₆
    have h₂₃ : a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z = 0 := h₇
    have h₂₄ : a 3 * x + a 4 * y + a 5 * z = 0 := h₈
    have h₂₅ : a 6 * x + a 7 * y + a 8 * z = 0 := h₉
    -- Multiply the first equation by (a₃ + a₄ + a₅) and the second by (a₆ + a₇ + a₈)
    have h₂₆ : (a 3 + a 4 + a 5) * (a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z) + (a 6 + a 7 + a 8) * (a 3 * x + a 4 * y + a 5 * z) > 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos h₁₁ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 3 + a 4 + a 5),
        mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 6 + a 7 + a 8) h₁₂,
        mul_pos h₁₃ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 3 + a 4 + a 5),
        mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 6 + a 7 + a 8) h₁₂,
        mul_pos h₁₁ h₁₄, mul_pos h₁₁ h₁₅,
        mul_pos h₁₂ h₁₄, mul_pos h₁₂ h₁₅,
        mul_pos h₁₃ h₁₄, mul_pos h₁₃ h₁₅,

        mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 3 + a 4 + a 5) h₁₅,
        mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 6 + a 7 + a 8) h₁₄,
        mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < a 6 + a 7 + a 8) h₁₅]
    -- Use the fact that the expression is positive to derive a contradiction
    have h₂₇ : (a 3 + a 4 + a 5) * (a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z) + (a 6 + a 7 + a 8) * (a 3 * x + a 4 * y + a 5 * z) = 0 := by
      calc
        (a 3 + a 4 + a 5) * (a 0 * x + a 1 * y + a 2 * z) + (a 6 + a 7 + a 8) * (a 3 * x + a 4 * y + a 5 * z)
          = (a 3 + a 4 + a 5) * 0 + (a 6 + a 7 + a 8) * 0 := by
            rw [h₂₃, h₂₄]
            <;> ring_nf
          _ = 0 := by ring_nf
    linarith
  
  have h₁₁ : y = 0 := by

    have h₁₂ : a 0 > 0 := h₀.1

  have h₁₂ : z = 0 := by

    have h₃₀ : a 2 * z = 0 := by linarith

    have h₃₂ : z = 0 := by

have h_imp : (∀ a b, f (2 * a) + 2 * f b = f (f (a + b))) → ∀ z, f z = 0 ∨ ∃ c, ∀ z, f z = 2 * z + c := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : f 0 = 0 := by
      have h₂ := h 0 0
      have h₃ := h 0 (2 * 0)
      have h₄ := h 0 (2 * 0)
      have h₅ := h 0 (2 * 0)
      have h₆ := h 0 (2 * 0)
      ring_nf at h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅ h₆ ⊢
      <;> linarith
    have h₂ : ∀ (a : ℤ), f (2 * a) = 2 * f a := by
      intro a
      have h₃ := h a 0
      have h₄ := h 0 a
      have h₅ := h a a
      have h₆ := h 0 (2 * a)
      have h₇ := h a 2 * a
      have h₈ := h (2 * a) 0
      have h₉ := h (2 * a) a
      ring_nf at h₃ h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇ h₈ h₉ ⊢
      <;>
      (try omega) <;>
      (try linarith) <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        }) <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        })
      <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        })
      <;>

        })

        })
      <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        })
      <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        })
    have h₃ : ∀ (a : ℤ), f a = 0 := by
      intro a
      have h₄ := h a a
      have h₅ := h 0 a
      have h₆ := h a 0
      have h₇ := h 0 0
      have h₈ := h 2 * a a
      have h₉ := h a 2 * a
      have h₁₀ := h (2 * a) a
      have h₁₁ := h (2 * a) (2 * a)
      ring_nf at h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇ h₈ h₉ h₁₀ h₁₁ ⊢
      <;>
      (try omega) <;>
      (try linarith) <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        }) <;>

        })

        })

        })
      <;>

        {

        })
      <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        })
      <;>
      (try
        {
          nlinarith [h₁]
        })
    intro z
    have h₄ : f z = 0 := h₃ z
    exact Or.inl h₄
  
  have h_converse : (∀ z, f z = 0 ∨ ∃ c, ∀ z, f z = 2 * z + c) → (∀ a b, f (2 * a) + 2 * f b = f (f (a + b))) := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : f = fun _ => 0 := by
      have h₂ : ∀ (z : ℤ), f z = 0 := by
        intro z
        by_cases hz : f z = 0
        · exact hz
        · -- If f(z) ≠ 0, then there exists a c such that f(z) = 2z + c
          have h₃ : ∃ (c : ℤ), ∀ (z : ℤ), f z = 2 * z + c := by
            exact h z
          obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h₃
          have h₄ := hc z
          have h₅ := hc 0
          have h₆ := hc 1
          have h₇ := hc (-1)
          have h₈ := hc 2
          have h₉ := hc (-2)
          have h₁₀ := hc 3
          have h₁₁ := hc (-3)
          have h₁₂ := hc 4
          have h₁₃ := hc (-4)
          -- Simplify the equations to find contradictions
          norm_num at h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇ h₈ h₉ h₁₀ h₁₁ h₁₂ h₁₃ ⊢
          <;>
          (try omega) <;>
          (try
            {
              have h₁₄ : c = 0 := by
                nlinarith
              subst_vars
              <;> simp_all
              <;> omega
            }) <;>
          (try
            {
              have h₁₄ : c = 0 := by
                nlinarith
              subst_vars
              <;> simp_all
              <;> omega
            })
          <;>
          (try omega)
      funext z
      exact h₂ z
    have h₂ : ∀ a b, f (2 * a) + 2 * f b = f (f (a + b)) := by
      intro a b
      have h₃ : f (2 * a) = 0 := by
        have h₄ := h₁ (2 * a)
        simp [h₁] at h₄ ⊢
      have h₄ : f b = 0 := by
        have h₅ := h₁ b
        simp [h₁] at h₅ ⊢
      have h₅ : f (a + b) = 0 := by
        have h₆ := h₁ (a + b)
        simp [h₁] at h₆ ⊢
      have h₆ : f (f (a + b)) = 0 := by
        have h₇ := h₁ (f (a + b))
        simp [h₁] at h₇ ⊢
      simp [h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all
      <;> linarith
    exact h₂
  
  constructor
  · -- Prove the forward direction: if the functional equation holds, then for every z, either f(z) = 0 or f(z) = 2z + c for some constant c.
    exact h_imp

            norm_num
            <;>
            omega
          })
  
  have h₉ : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ = 2 := by
    have h₉₁ : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), ( (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ : ZMod p) = (1 : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((p - 1 : ZMod p))⁻¹ := h₄
    have h₉₂ : ( (1 : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((p - 1 : ZMod p))⁻¹ : ZMod p) = 2 := h₈
    have h₉₃ : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ = 2 := by
      calc
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), ( (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ : ZMod p) := by
          simp [ZMod.nat_cast_self]
        _ = (1 : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((p - 1 : ZMod p))⁻¹ := by rw [h₉₁]
        _ = 2 := by
          simpa [ZMod.nat_cast_self] using h₉₂
    exact h₉₃
  
  exact h₉
